z-m-30-01.title: Chii chinotevera 1, 2, 4?
z-m-30-01.topic: Masimba ematrix: kukosha kwakawanda sei kunodiwa kugadzirisa mutsetse?
z-m-30-01.goal: Ziva kuti mumasimba ematrix, mitemo yakawanda inogona kuenderana nenhamba shoma yemakosha, sefa mitemo inokwanisika uye ugadzirise kutonga kwako sezvaunofamba, uye utsanangure kuti unogona kuva nechokwadi chefomula yakazara chete mushure mekuwana chikonzero (chimiro).
z-m-30-01.material: B imatrix ye 2×2, uye entries dzayo ina (mutsara 1 koramu 1, mutsara 1 koramu 2, mutsara 2 koramu 1, mutsara 2 koramu 2) dzose dzi1. B^n imatrix yaunowana nekuwanza B n nguva. Entries dzose nhamba chaidzo uye n i integer ine 1 kana kupfuura. Shamwari mbiri dziri kutaura nezve entries dze B³. Imwe inoti, "Entries dze B¹ ne B² ndi1 ne2, saka B³ i3," uye imwe inoti, "Handisati ndava nechokwadi. Ngatiwanzei zvakawanda." Nguva imwe neimwe data ichibuda, gadzirisa kutonga kwako kana kuchengeta.
z-m-30-01.thinking.0: Kuwedzera mutemo kubva padata shoma, uchifungawo mimwe mitemo inogoneka
z-m-30-01.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga nekuvimba kwako zvichienderana neruzivo rutsva
z-m-30-01.thinking.2: Kuwana mutsara wekutanga unoenda zvisirizvo mumhinduro nekutsanangura chikonzero
z-m-30-01.thinking.3: Kugadzira fomula yakazara uchishandisa mavara (p, n) nekunyora chikonzero
z-m-30-01.prereq.0: Kuwanza mamatrix e 2×2 (entry imwe yechigadzirwa = huwandu hwezvigadzirwa zvema entries emutsara mumwe wematrix ekumberi nekoramu imwe yematrix ekumashure) nemasimba A^n = A yakawanzwa n nguva
z-m-30-01.prereq.1: Kuverenga maexpression ane mavara n ne p uye kuwana mitsetse yakareruka yenhamba
z-m-30-01.prereq.2: Fungidziro yeurongwa hwechikoro: H2 yebasa iri ingori chinyorwa chekuoma mukugadzira uye hairevi kuti Ministry of Education inogovera zvinyorwa izvi kugiredhi rakati. Tinofungidzira kuti inouya pakarepo mushure mekudzidza kuwanza mamatrix, uye induction kana determinants hazvidiwi.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.prompt: Data inobuda danho rimwe panguva. Panhanho yega yega, sarudza kutonga kwako kwazvino nezve entries dzemasimba e B dzichava dzakaita sei.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, nyora mitemo yose inoenderana nenhamba dzekusvika zvino, uye uenzanise kuti ruzivo rutsva runobvisa ipi yadzo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ongorora kana wakasarudza nekufunga mutemo mumwe chete, kana wakafungawo mimwe mitemo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.info: B¹ i B pachayo, saka entries dzose ina dzi1. Kana B² yakawanzwa zvakananga, entries dzose ina dzakanga dzi2.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Entries dze B³ dzakaita sei? Sarudza kutonga kwako kwazvino.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Data mbiri idzi dzinotsanangura zvose 3 ne4. Unogona kutora mutemo mumwe se 'fungidziro yekushanda,' asi usati waongorora zvine musoro kuchengeta kutonga kwako kwakavhurika.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Entries dzose dzi3. Shure kwe1, 2, mutemo wekuwedzera ne1 unoenderera
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Pane mitemo inoenderana ne1, 2 kunze kwe 'wedzera ne1.' Nenhamba mbiri dze data chete, zvakangoerekana kusarudza mutemo mumwe.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Entries dzose dzi4. Shure kwe1, 2, mutemo wekupetwa kaviri unoenderera
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Mutemo wekuwanza ne 2 unokodzerawo 1, 2, asi 'wedzera 1' inokodzerawo. Cherekedza kuti kwakare kusarudza imwe chete uye kuva nechokwadi.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hatigone kusarudza pakati pe 3 ne 4 zvino, saka tarisa nekuwanza B³ zvakananga
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaziva kuti mapoindi edata maviri anokodzera mitemo yakati wandei uye wakaisa kutonga kwako shure. Wakafungawo nezvechiito chekutarisa (kuwanza zvakananga).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ma entries ese i 2. I matrix ine ma entries ese akafanana, saka mutengo hauchachinji
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Mu B², mutengo wakatochinja kubva ku 1 kuenda ku 2. Kuti ma entries akafanana hakusi kuti mutengo hauchinji.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Kana B³ yakawanzwa zvakananga, ma entries mana ese aiva 4. Kusvika zvino i 1, 2, 4. Mutemo unokodzera nhamba idzi hausi 'kuwanza ne 2' chete. Kuwedzera mitengo miviri yapfuura wobva wawedzera 1 kunopa 1, 2, 4, 7, ..., uye izvi zvinokodzerawo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Nekuda kwe B³, 'wedzera 1' yabviswa. Asi mutemo wekuwanza ne 2 nemutemo we 1, 2, 4, 7 hazvigoni kusiyaniswa kusvikira B⁴ yaverengwa. Unofanira kuunganidza data yakawanda kana kutsvaga chikonzero.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sarudza mutemo wekuwanza ne 2 uye unyore kuti ma entries ese e B⁴ i 8
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Chokwadi kuti mitengo mitatu inokodzera kuwanza ne 2, asi mutemo we 1, 2, 4, 7 unokodzerawo. Hausati wavapatsanura.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Tora 4 ye B³ sekukanganisa kuverenga uye uchengete mutemo wekutanga wekuti ese i 3
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kana ukapomera mutengo wakaverengwa zvakananga kukukanganisa, unogona kuchengeta kutonga kwako kwekutanga asi hauna hwaro. Kutarisazve kuverenga kwakasiyana nekukurasa.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Pane mitemo yakati wandei, saka usafungidzira chinhu chose kubva padata iyi
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Wedzera 1' haichakodzeri. Kuti mitemo yasara yaderedzwa nhamba zvakare i ruzivo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Rasa 'wedzera 1,' uye upatsanure mitemo miviri yasara ne B⁴
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakarasa mutemo usingakodzeri data uye wakafungawo nzira yekupatsanura mitemo yasara.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ndakatsvaga chikonzero. Regai ma entries mana ese e B^n ive nhamba imwechete k. Entry imwe ye B^(n+1) = B^n × B i (k × 1) + (k × 1) = 2k. I kuverenga kumwechete kuma entries mana ese. Ma entries ese e B¹ i 1.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zvino unotonga sei ma entries e B^n ne B⁵?
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Chimiro chekuti ma entries ese akafanana chinochengetwa nguva dzose uye mutengo unowanzwa ne 2, saka ma entries e B^n i 2^(n−1). Kutonga kwakasiyiwa kwakazaruka pakutanga se 'i 3 kana 4' kwakaderedzwa nekurongeka data → mitemo inogoneka → chikonzero. Mudzidzi akaverenga B⁴ zvakananga anosvika pamhedziso imwechete.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ma entries e B^n ese i n, uye e B⁵ ese i 5
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mutemo wa n watoenda zvisirizvo pa B³. Hauzikodzerizve ruzivo rutsva (2k nguva imwe neimwe kana tichiwanza).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ma entries e B^n ese i 2^(n−1), uye e B⁵ ese i 16
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakabatanidza kusvika kuchikonzero che 'kuwanza kwega kwega kunopa 2k' kunoshanda ku n ipi neipi.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Zvingangoita 2^(n−1), asi handizokwanisa kuva nechokwadi ndisati ndawanza B⁵ zvakananga
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Maitiro ekuda kutarisa akanaka. Asi ruzivo rutsva i chikonzero chinoshanda ku n ipi neipi. Funga kuti chikonzero ichocho chinokanganisa sei kuvimba kwako.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: B⁴ i 7, saka B⁵ ese i 12
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakachengeta mutemo we 1, 2, 4, 7. Tarisa kana unokodzera ruzivo rutsva rwekuti k inova 2k.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.reflect: Kubva pakuisa kutonga kwako shure pakutanga kusvika pakuva nechokwadi pakupedzisira, chii chakachinja kuvimba kwako? Kuunganidza mapoindi edata matatu akawanda nekutsvaga 'chikonzero' kwakaita musiyano wei kukuvimba kwako?
z-m-30-01.s.s2.prompt: Hayun, shamwari yekirasi, akawana ma entries e powers e C = 3B (matrix ine ma entries mana ese i 3) sezvazviri pazasi. Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga unokanganisa.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza imwe yema entries e C uye uverenge zvakananga entry (mutsetse 1, koramu 1) ye C yakawanzwa pachayo kaviri.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa mutengo wakaverengwa zvakananga nemutengo wemutsetse wega wega uye utsvage mutsetse wekutanga apo dzinosiyana.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.1: Ma entries ese e B² i 2, saka ma entries ese e C² i 3 × 2 = 6.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.2: Nenzira imwechete C³ = 3B³, uye ma entries ese e B³ i 4, saka ma entries ese e C³ i 3 × 4 = 12.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.3: Saka ma entries e C^n i 3 × 2^(n−1).
z-m-30-01.s.s2.explain: Mumutsetse 1, constant 3 iripo kamwe mune rimwe nerimwe remafactor maviri, asi yakabviswa kamwe chete. Mu (3B)(3B) 3 inoonekwa kaviri, saka C² = 9B², uye ma entries ese i 9 × 2 = 18. Kana ukawanza C pachayo uye ukaverenga entry imwe chete, 3×3 + 3×3 = 18, saka unogona kusimbisa kuti inosiyana ne 6. Mitsetse 2 kusvika ku 4 yakagara nhaka mutsara wemutsetse 1 uye yakaipa. Mutsetse 3 zvakare, nechikonzero chimwechete: C³ = 27B³ uye ma entries i 108.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, funga matrix P ine ma entries mana ese i p (p i positive integer). Taura ma entries e P^n, P yakawanzwa n nguva, nenzira ye p ne n, uye unyore kuti nei unogona kutaura saizvozvo.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuna p=1 ne p=2, wanza P² zvakananga uye uenzanise ma entries.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora semutsara kuti ma entries e P² anobatana sei nema entries e P ne p, uye utarise kana zvimwechete zvichiitika mu P³.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Ma entries e P^n i ... Nekuti ...
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Entry 2^(n−1) ye B^n inobudazve mumutsara wangu kana p=1 here?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakatarisa kuti inoenderana nemitengo yakawanzwa zvakananga nekuisa n=1 ne n=2 here?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakanyora kasiketi kechikonzero, sa 'nei kuverenga entry imwe kwakakwana' kana 'nekubvisa B' here?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.0: Ma entries e P^n ese i p^n × 2^(n−1). Kana tikanyora P = pB, saka P^n = p^n B^n, uye ma entries e B^n anowanzwa ne 2 nguva imwe neimwe.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.1: Sa p, 2p², 4p³, ..., ma entries anova 2p nguva akakura nguva imwe neimwe tichiwanza kamwe. Ma entries mana anochengeta chimiro chimwechete uye entry imwe i p×k + p×k = 2pk, saka ma entries e P^n i p × (2p)^(n−1).
z-m-30-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Nzira inotanga kubva pashanduko yekuwanza kumwe. Mutsara wakafanana nemhinduro yapfuura.
